name: United Kingdom: national skeleton
about: Skeleton of the United Kingdom for the globe of the Three.js port (OKR KR2.7): open vector layers simplified for national to city scale, a gazetteer and place cards. Great Britain for the OS layers (OS OpenData has no Northern Ireland); the whole UK for the ONS boundaries and the Wikidata places.
crs: WGS84 longitude, latitude in degrees (EPSG:4326 axis order lon, lat as GeoJSON)
heights: none (2D); terrain comes from the world DEM of the globe

transformation.horizontal: EPSG:27700 (British National Grid; ONS publishes Northern Ireland in it too)
transformation.transformation: OSTN15 (OS NTv2 grid uk_os_OSTN15_NTv2_OSGBtoETRS.tif) through proj4, both ways; ETRS89 used as WGS84 (about 0.9 m apart in 2026)

format: skeleton-1: GeoJSON-like FeatureCollection with integer, delta-coded coordinates (q = 10^decimals); docklands/geo/skeleton.js unpack() gives GeoJSON

cells.y: floor((lat + 90) / size), counted from the south (3D Tiles 1.1 implicit tiling, region volume)
cells.levelForSpan: span of the view in degrees of latitude: > 6 -> national, > 1.2 -> regional, else city (docklands/geo/skeleton.js levelForSpan)
cells.files: polygons whole in the cell of their bbox centre (file bbox = real extent); lines clipped at cell edges, one piece per cell, id <feature>.<n>; points in their cell

gazetteer.about: Names for search: OS Open Names (settlements, hills, water, islands, stations, airports, ports, hospitals, universities, numbered roads; not the 0.9 million street names, woods or schools), postcode districts (mean of their postcodes), named rivers of 5 km or more (OS Open Rivers), ONS countries, regions, counties, districts and national parks, the landscape designations, and Wikidata settlements of Northern Ireland
gazetteer.key: the first two letters or digits of the folded name (docklands/geo/skeleton.js fold, gazKey); a name is also filed under its other-language form and under the name without a generic first word (prefixes: River Thames under th)
fields: id (OS Open Names id, ONS code, NaPTAN-free; Wikidata QID for Wikidata-only places)

kinds.suburb: suburb or district of a town

cards.about: place cards by Wikidata QID, in the regional-level cell of the Wikidata point

fields.links: wikidata, wikipedia (+ wikipediaTitle), image (Commons file page; + imageFile), website: links only, no copied text or image
fields.district: the district (ONS) that holds the point; its 2021 census population is on the districts layer (pop2021)
